mapper.select: SELECT h.CHECKED_AT AS checkedAt, h.PRICE AS price, pc.PLATFORM_NAME AS platformName FROM car_price_history h JOIN platform_car pc ON h.PLATFORM_CAR_ID = pc.PLATFORM_CAR_ID WHERE h.PLATFORM_CAR_ID = #{platformCarId} ORDER BY h.CHECKED_AT ASC
